stance_summary: Post-FOMC long-10Y / bull-flatten is already owned in price and holdings; CAD and JPY FX crowding has either covered or already jumped, so the cleaner fade is a US 2s10s steepener against asset-manager 10Y length rather than joining duration longs or chasing spot.

expression_comparison.rates_candidate: Short US_2s10s at the frozen 25.0bp mark (executable_marks.rates.US_2s10s / market_state.rates.US.curves.2s10s.bps as of 2026-09-18): a curve steepener that pays 10s versus 2s in paper-book units.
expression_comparison.spot_candidate: Long USDJPY at the frozen 157.88830715532288 ECB reference (executable_marks.spot_fx.USDJPY) to fade CFTC leveraged-fund JPY net length at the 1y 99th percentile.
expression_comparison.rationale: Rates are cleaner. US 2s10s still sits at the 1y 0.198th percentile after the hike, so the crowded bull-flatten has not unwound in the rates market that asset-manager 10Y length actually owns. USDJPY already printed a +1.4106659832314294% 1d move (screen z 2.726) after the 2026-09-17 BoJ hike, while CFTC is stale as of 2026-09-15 and CME positioning is unavailable, so the FX fade is a post-event chase with unknown current ownership. Outright short US_10Y was considered and rejected as a bad entry: the 10Y yield is already at the 1y 99.603th percentile even though AM length remains crowded.

trade.structure: Outright short US 2s10s curve (paper steepener: short 10s vs long 2s in book units).
trade.thesis: VERIFIED: Fed hiked 25bp to 3.75-4.00% on the 2026-09-16 decision after interest-rate futures had priced a greater-than-90% probability of that hike; August CPI is retained as keeping the tightening bias intact. US 2s10s is 25.0bp as of 2026-09-18, 1y percentile 0.198, z_1y -2.447, and -21.0bp over 1m. US 10Y yield is 5.01% at 1y percentile 99.603. CFTC TFF futures-only as of 2026-09-15: asset-manager UST 10Y net long 2634980 contracts (48.997% of open interest), 1y percentile 91.346 / 3y percentile 97.115; leveraged-fund UST 2Y still net short 1294575 but at 1y percentile 93.269 / 3y percentile 97.756 of net (least-short/most-long in that window) with weekly net change only -4096; leveraged-fund CAD still net short 39022 but 1y percentile 99.038 with weekly net covering +16426; leveraged-fund JPY net long 23170, 1y percentile 99.038, z_1y +3.713, weekly net +72268; AUD open interest 493141 at 1y percentile 99.038 / 3y z +5.422. CME daily FX OI is unavailable. Persistent paper books are empty $100m seeds. US temperatures: inflation 52.0, labor 50.2, activity 49.92, consumer 48.5. INFERENCE: the room-consensus post-hike trades—long 10s, bull-flatten, short CAD, long JPY—are either already owned or already covering. Holder composition matters: AM 10Y length is preferred-habitat crowding that has already been paid via the 21bp 1m flatten, so joining those longs is a bad trade; paying outright 10s at the 99.6th yield percentile is a bad entry for a right crowding call. The steepener fades the owned flatten where price is stretched and AM 2Y length is not crowded (AM UST 2Y net percentile 12.5 1y / 24.0 3y). CAD FX shorts have already covered, so USDCAD is the wrong expression of residual Canada-dove pricing. UNKNOWN: CFTC is four days stale and straddles FOMC; post-15 Sep dealer/CTA/options ownership is unobserved; no CGB futures book exists in the packet. FALSIFIER is continued bull-flatten that confirms the AM 10Y easing-path ownership rather than unwinding it.
trade.mispricing: Market-vs-market and ownership-vs-price: the post-hike easing/flatten path is in the 1y extreme of US 2s10s (25.0bp, 0.198th percentile) while the holder of that view—asset-manager 10Y net length—is itself at a 3y 97th percentile. That is crowded ownership sitting on an already-completed price move, not a fresh discrepancy.
why_now: The 25bp hike is a known event that was greater-than-90% priced before the decision; known information needs a new transmission path, and the remaining path the crowd owns is bull-flatten/long 10s.
US 2s10s is still at the 1y flatten extreme (25.0bp) after the 2026-09-18 observation, so the crowded rates expression has not mean-reverted.
CFTC shows AM 10Y net length still historically elevated as of 2026-09-15 while leveraged-fund 2Y shorts have already covered to a 3y 97.8th percentile of net, exhausting the front-end squeeze bid.
Being flat does not stop the 5% ACT/365 charge on the full $100m; empty seed books make a defined-invalidation fade of the owned flatten preferable to collecting vig with no risk.

rollup:BoJ raises its policy rate to 1.25%
rollup:BoC minutes flag higher energy pass-through risk
trade.horizon: 2-6 weeks, through the next US inflation/labor prints that can force AM 10Y length to reassess the easing-path flatten.
trade.invalidation: Invalidated if the owned bull-flatten is confirmed rather than unwound: US 2s10s remains pinned at the 1y extreme while asset-manager UST 10Y net length stays historically elevated, or if incoming US data/Fed communication clearly re-opens an easing path those 10Y longs are built to own. Do not invent a stop yield or spread.
catalysts: Follow-through from August CPI / retained Fed tightening-bias narrative into the next US inflation or labor release.
Any post-FOMC communication that keeps the terminal-rate distribution from collapsing into the crowded long-10Y / flatten book.
BoC energy pass-through minutes plus Canada activity temperature 53.2 as a reason the Canada-dove/CAD-short complex should not be used as a substitute expression.
principal_risks: CFTC TFF is age_days 4 and dated 2026-09-15, so FOMC-week repositioning is unobserved; CME volume/OI is unavailable.
Asset-manager 10Y length is preferred-habitat and can remain sticky, capping a bear-steepener even if the idea is crowded.
Residual leveraged-fund 10Y shorts are still large in contracts (-1868126, -34.74% of OI) and could squeeze, producing more flatten.
A genuine growth-break (US activity 49.92, consumer 48.5) would validate the crowded easing-path longs.
Paper curve P&L uses simplified yield/spread units; this is not a DV01-neutral listed butterfly.

remit: attack crowded ideas; prefer better ownership asymmetry

conflict_synopsis.core_view: Fade the already-owned post-hike bull-flatten/long-10Y complex with a US 2s10s steepener; do not join duration longs or chase CAD/JPY FX after covering and a 1d USDJPY jump.
conflict_synopsis.key_catalyst: Next US inflation/labor print that forces crowded AM 10Y flattening longs to reassess the post-hike easing path.
conflict_synopsis.key_invalidation: Bull-flatten remains pinned at the 1y extreme while AM 10Y net length stays historically elevated, or data re-open an easing path those longs own.

paper_capital.funding_hurdle_rationale: The seat pays 5.00% ACT/365 on the full $100m whether flat or not; empty seed books mean HOLD still burns vig. $20m short US_2s10s is sized to make a partial unwind of the sourced -21.0bp 1m flatten matter versus that clock without using the whole allocation on one curve. Joining crowded long-10Y/flatten has the worse expected payoff because that move is already in the 1y 0.198th percentile. This rationale does not author canonical P&L, funding, NAV, or rank.
